query: For an elemental Cr coating on a zirconium-alloy fuel-cladding substrate, what single intervention could prevent premature coating failure caused by elevated-temperature Cr–Zr interdiffusion while preserving protection under both normal subcritical-water operation and accident-relevant high-temperature steam? Formulate one hypothesis that identifies the intervention, explains the mechanism, predicts performance relative to the unmodified Cr-coated baseline, defines the relevant temperature, exposure-time, and environmental boundaries, cites supporting prior evidence, and specifies a discriminating experiment and outcome that would falsify the hypothesis.

generation.hypothesis: The introduction of a thin, continuous alumina (Al2O3) layer between the elemental Cr coating and the zirconium-alloy fuel-cladding substrate can prevent premature coating failure caused by elevated-temperature Cr–Zr interdiffusion.
generation.material_initial_state: Elemental Cr coating on a zirconium-alloy fuel-cladding substrate
generation.intervention: Introduction of a thin, continuous alumina (Al2O3) layer
generation.conditions: Elevated temperatures, subcritical-water operation, and high-temperature steam
generation.mechanism: The alumina layer acts as a diffusion barrier, preventing Cr–Zr interdiffusion and reducing the risk of coating failure
generation.predicted_outcome: Improved coating performance and preservation of protection under both normal and accident-relevant conditions
generation.boundary: Temperature: up to 1200°C, exposure time: up to 100 hours, environment: subcritical water and high-temperature steam
generation.uncertainty: The exact thickness and microstructure of the alumina layer required for optimal performance are unknown

falsification_experiment.design: Compare the performance of Cr-coated zirconium-alloy fuel-cladding substrates with and without the alumina layer under elevated-temperature steam exposure
measurements: Coating thickness, microstructure, and composition; substrate-coating interdiffusion; coating failure rate
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If the alumina-layered coating exhibits no significant improvement in performance or increased interdiffusion compared to the unmodified Cr-coated baseline, the hypothesis is falsified
